1525626450.title: Rensselaer County
1525626450.creator: Rensselaer County Official
1525626450.description:
Join our Community Group: https://www.roblox.com/communities/5499489/Rensselaer-County-Official

If you're on PC, when in vehicle, press 'E' three times to set your gearing to Drive. 'E' and 'Q' are used to switch gears.

Welcome to Rensselaer County! Located in New York, hit the road and embark on an immersive driving adventure. This open-world driving game offers lots of opportunities for exploration, with a vast network of roads, an interstate, and charming houses to discover.

badges.name: Welcome!
badges.desc: You joined the game for the first time! Enjoy your stay!

badges.name: Speedy Egg
badges.desc: 110 MPH in a 70 MPH zone is not enough. This egg's just getting started.

badges.name: Friendly Egg
badges.desc: This little egg is your average blossoming social butterfly. Become his friend, you know you wanna.

badges.name: Honk Egg
badges.desc: HONK and go. This egg's got places to be.

badges.name: Gas Station Egg
badges.desc: I'm not paying $6.50/Gallon, that's outrageous! This egg raised the prices anyway.

badges.name: Meow Egg
badges.desc: Meow. Meow. Quit acting cute! Never mind, you know I didn't mean it. This egg wins every argument

badges.name: Jumpy Egg
badges.desc: Boing! Boing! Boing! Boing!... Boing!... Boing?...

badges.name: Race Egg
badges.desc: Ready. Get Set. Go! Once this egg starts, there's no stopping it.

badges.name: Crosswalk Egg
badges.desc: Walk! Walk! Walk! This egg's urging you forward. Always forward.

badges.name: Emote Egg
badges.desc: This egg knows moves when they see it. One emote, and you're hooked.

badges.name: Music Egg
badges.desc: Ever met an egg that can listen to anything? Well. Now you have.

badges.name: Dumpster Egg
badges.desc: I'm one with the trash; I will be the trash. This egg's at peace.

badges.name: Passenger Egg
badges.desc: Okay, you don't need to buckle up that much! I'm not that dangerous!

badges.name: Mailman Egg
badges.desc: There's nothing this egg loves more than delivering the mail.

badges.name: Bridge Egg
badges.desc: Forged from humanity's desire to cross rivers, this egg stays true to its roots and its bridges.

badges.name: Garden Egg
badges.desc: Ah, the bliss of nature. Truly a gift to the eyes. This egg knows it well.

badges.name: Pool Egg
badges.desc: The root of all the summer fun you've enjoyed over the years. This egg was there for it all.

badges.name: Heist Egg
badges.desc: Grrr. Let's rob a bank, grrr. This egg has a plan. Probably a terrible one.

badges.name: Trivia Egg
badges.desc: Let's see if it's right! This egg's a trivia master. Are you?

badges.name: Rooftop Egg
badges.desc: This egg stands between you and the sky. Be grateful.

badges.name: Invisible Egg
badges.desc: Visible one minute, gone the next. This egg's a magician without the tricks.

badges.name: Photo Egg
badges.desc: *FLASH* Yess, strike a pose. This egg's a natural in front of the lens.

badges.name: Copy Egg
badges.desc: Who designed this egg to look like a chick? It should have been a parrot! After all, that's what you do, parrot what it says.

badges.name: Billboard Egg
badges.desc: Bloxy Cola Zero Sugar, you know you want it. This egg's the pitch. And it never stops selling.

badges.name: DJ Egg
badges.desc: Hey DJ! Play E#### by R###. This egg's spinning the tracks you didn't know you needed.

badges.name: Bench Egg
badges.desc: Can only be fitted in parks, batteries not included*. This egg doesn't move. Ever.

badges.name: Junkyard Egg
badges.desc: Why do we still have this scrap lying around? This egg's been forgotten in the junkyard.

badges.name: Mimic Egg
badges.desc: YoU cAn'T fInD mE. This egg is already everywhere.

badges.name: Night Egg
badges.desc: Slumbering under the crescent moon, this egg dreams of eternal night and the peace it brings.

badges.name: Firefighter Egg
badges.desc: Who you gonna call? This firefighter egg. Who's gonna actually help? EMS.

badges.name: Tunnel Egg
badges.desc: The underground route? That's this egg's domain.

badges.name: Maze Egg
badges.desc: Wander long enough and you'll find this egg at the center, grinning.

badges.name: Parkour Egg
badges.desc: This egg's recklessness is matched only by its skill. A dangerous combination.

badges.name: Fisch Egg
badges.desc: Glup glup, glup glup glup. Glup! glup glup glup. This egg's a fish. What did you expect?

badges.name: Demon Egg
badges.desc: Born from pure corruption, this egg exists only to sow discord and ruin.

badges.name: Stealth Egg
badges.desc: Those eyes, man... eeek. This egg sees everything.

badges.name: Cemetery Egg
badges.desc: This egg doesn't belong here. Neither do the spirits. But neither is leaving.

badges.name: Backwards Egg
badges.desc: .strange is this, backwards being about all is egg This

badges.name: Clown Egg
badges.desc: Can someone tell this egg to quit its antics? No one can. It won't listen. It never listens.

badges.name: Lightning Egg
badges.desc: Lightningstruck! Lightningstruck, yeah, yeah. This egg rocks harder than electricity itself.

💰 Rob the bank, jeweler, and harbor containers, escape the police, and get rich as a criminal.
🚒 Extinguish fires as a firefighter, revive downed players as a medic.
🔧 Tow broken vehicles and repair traffic lights as a car mechanic.
🚚 Deliver cargo as a truck driver. 
🚌 Drive city and rural bus routes.
🚗 Earn money, buy your dream car, and tune it your way.
🗺️ Explore Hamburg and write your own story as a civilian.

5750914919.creator: Fisching
5750914919.description:
🦈 Welcome to Fisch 🦈

Dive into Fisch, the ultimate fishing adventure where exploration and progression are yours to control. Cast your line to catch rare and unique fish, each with 400,000+ possible variations. Explore a growing world with your trusty rod, and maybe even reel in some new friends along the way!

[How To Fish]
• Hold down to cast your bobber
• Await a bite. You can "shake" your rod to attract fish faster
• When you have a bite, hold down or click to pull the white bar. Follow the blue line to the best of your ability; it's okay to mess up a few times!
• When the progress bar on the bottom is full, you'll reel in your catch!

10766456501.creator: Roblox Presents
10766456501.description:
Go back through 20 years of Roblox and experience where it all began, one era at a time. Some games will feel instantly familiar. Others may surprise you. And there's always more to the story.

Subscribe to Roblox Plus to get early access to the hub and up to three additional exclusive items during the event. Early access runs from 9 AM to 2 PM PDT.

💠 Discover iconic games throughout Roblox history.
💠 Complete event quests to unlock rare and exclusive rewards.
💠 Interact with creators you know and love.
💠 Experience nostalgia in whole new ways.
💠 Stay tuned for more surprises as The Hunt: Roblox 20 unfolds.
 
It’s all happening right here from September 17-28.

Give your clones an idea and watch them get to work! Clone Builders is an experimental building sandbox where NPC clones use a structured building system to place, resize, move, and assemble parts into creations inside the world.

🧪 This game is also a testing ground for some of our bigger clone-related projects. Systems, behaviors, building techniques, and other experiments tested here may eventually find their way into future games. 🧪

🏗️ Give your clones a challenge. 🏗️
👷 Watch them figure it out. 👷
🧪 Break our experiments. 🧪
🌎 See what they can build! 🌎

Clone Builders is constantly evolving, so expect experiments, strange clone behavior, new features, and probably a few disasters along the way.

🚨 Clone Builders does NOT use AI for builds!! 🚨

*A private server is highly recommended for building large-scale builds/minigames*

Inspired by @Resurrected_Dove's NPC Builders.

10764769092.creator: Broken Timeline
10764769092.description:
You checked into the hotel. You don't remember when.

Every door is locked. The elevator needs three keycards, and they're scattered across a building that isn't empty something very tall Its the Cat in the Hat its walking the corridors, and it can hear you.

Search the guest rooms, the offices and the service wing to find all three. Sprint if you have to, but it hears you run. Crouch and it hears nothing at all. Your flashlight shows you the way and shows it exactly where you are.

You get three lives. It only needs one.

Play solo or with up to 3 friends.

CONTROLS
Sprint — Shift / L3
Crouch — C / B
Flashlight — F / Y
Unlock Mouse PC - G
Mobile — on-screen buttons

👍 Enjoy the game and join the group.

🎧 Use headphones for the best experience.

❤️ Thank you for playing. Your support really helps with the development of the game.

10768944292.creator: Project Mirvy
10768944292.description:
🦖 Welcome to Prehistoric Farm 🦖

Dig up the past and bring it back to life! Sail across wild islands, unearth ancient fossils, and turn them into eggs at Dr. Ivy's DNA Lab. Hatch your very own dinosaurs, raise them from tiny Newborns into huge Elders, and ride them across your ranch!

[How To Play]
▪ Grab your shovel and hold down on a dig site. Let go when the meter is in the green for a better find!
▪ Collect a full set of fossils and bring them to Dr. Ivy to grow an egg
▪ Warm your egg in the incubator and watch it hatch
▪ Keep your dino's belly over half full so it keeps growing
▪ Once it's grown, hop on and ride your partner dino around the islands!

[Explore]
▪ Buy bigger boats and sail to new fossil islands
▪ Fish the open sea and dive for rare catches
▪ Sneak into the Sunken Grotto to steal sea reptile eggs
▪ Team up with other players to take down the giant Mosasaurus with spears!

Works on PC, mobile and console.

10743048214.title: FNaF World Multiplayer
10743048214.creator: Sunny_Verified
10743048214.description:
👍 LIKE = UPDATE

🎩 Welcome to FNAF World Multiplayer!

A fan-made recreation of the original FNaF World, aiming to recreate the original experience while adding multiplayer!

The game is currently in EARLY ACCESS and is not yet complete. Once the main game is finished, I plan to expand it with new areas, content, events, skins, and more!

🌲 Explore the world of FNaF World!
⚔️ Fight enemies and bosses!
🌟 Unlock characters and build your party!
🗺️ Find new areas and secrets!

Thumbnail by Deevee
Icon by VioletSchmidt

FNaF World is a FREE game originally created by Scott Cawthon and is available on Game Jolt.

All original FNAF World characters, music, and assets belong to Scott Cawthon and their respective owners. This is an unofficial fan game and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Scott Cawthon.
 
If requested by Scott Cawthon or the relevant rights holders, this game will be taken down.

10767634248.name: Firefighting Sim 🚒
10767634248.title: Firefighting Sim
10767634248.creator: Blackbox Express
10767634248.description:
🚒 Be a firefighter! Answer 911 calls, race your fire truck through Oak Ridge with sirens blaring, and battle fires that spread for real, in first person with your crew.

Someone's still inside. Go get them. 🔥

🚨 20+ fire trucks: engines, ladder towers, tankers, brush trucks, rescue ambulances & chief cars. Wail, yelp, and pull the air horn cord!
🪓 Force doors with axes & chainsaws, throw ladders, stretch hose lines, mask up in the smoke
🐕 Search burning buildings with your K9 partner
🏠 House, apartment & office fires, brush fires, car fires... and plane crashes at the airport ✈️
⛈️ Lightning storms, rain, day & night
🎖️ Rank up from Recruit to Fire Chief: grade your calls, earn badges, daily challenges & leaderboards
🎮 Play on PC, mobile & console with full controller support

The fire rescue simulator where every call is different.

FREE PRIVATE SERVERS!

Fight fires, have fun, be safe! 👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite for updates!

4342047058.creator: Guts & Blackpowder
4342047058.description:
Guts & Blackpowder is a game taking place during the Napoleonic Wars with the undead zombie masses rising from the ground. A group of survivors must hold out against the horde, only armed with muskets and swords. 

Clothing in the game is made by DrLivesey, Miscreantagent, and Ower, you can buy their clothing here 
https://www.roblox.com/groups/5466526/DrLiveseys 
https://www.roblox.com/groups/33978264
https://www.roblox.com/groups/33800174

UGC Hats Available! https://www.roblox.com/groups/16911831/Guts-Blackpowder#!/store

GAME RULES:
1. Exploiting is strictly forbidden and will result in permanent ban
2. Inappropriate chat messages and user-built structures are not allowed and will result in bans
3. Griefing, round delaying, stalling, or abusing glitches to intentionally ruin the game for other users will result in bans
4. Misusing the in-game reporter can result in bans
5. Adhere to Roblox's Terms of Use

10767621255.description:
Keep quiet. She hears everything.

You and your friends are trapped in the school after dark. The doors are locked, the lights flicker, and something is walking the halls. Every footstep, every slammed locker and every word you say into your mic tells her where you are.

And she already knows your name.

-1 to 6 players: solo, with friends or with strangers
-Find the codes and escape through one of the exits
-Hide in a locker... but you can't stay in there forever
-Voice chat makes it scarier, but you can play without a mic
-Easy, Normal, Hard and Insane: 4, 3, 2 or 1 lives per night. Out of lives? Spectate your friends
-Free to play: you can escape without buying anything
-Settings for flashing lights, jumpscare volume and performance mode
-Daily rewards, flashlight skins and codes

Get in the car with your friends. Don't scream.

10768422548.name: [Ch. 2 Pt. 2] PIPES 🔧
10768422548.title: PIPES
10768422548.creator: PartyBox!
10768422548.description:
You took the night shift at PIPE CO. Nobody told you what's down there.

Crawl through a maze of pitch-black pipes with nothing but a heater, a map, and a radio. Turn the valves, fix pipes, and do tasks, then get back to the safe room and clock out before things find you.

Something's always in the pipes with you.

Every night the pipes change. Every job you finish makes them angrier.

- 1-4 players co-op
- 2 chapters, 15 nights, plus a Custom Night gamepass
- 15+ unique monsters
- Hide in the walls, use your surroundings to survive.
- Furnish your safe room between shifts

Clock in. Don't stay late.

main menu music by @differentmentalway
(game inspired by Rodland of Pipes & Crawlspace 2 on Steam )

badges.name: First Shift
badges.desc: It opened its mouth in the dark and you made it home anyway. Next time it opens wide, let the dark have you.

badges.name: The Head
badges.desc: A grinning face scratched into the wall. A red face on your map. It’s slower than you. Remember that.

badges.name: The Works
badges.desc: It stares. You can’t move while it stares. Something about paper makes it look away.

badges.name: Into the Vents
badges.desc: They only want the light. You heard the wings and you gave them the dark.

badges.name: Ice Breaker
badges.desc: Sixty seconds. Somebody’s frozen in the dark and banging on the glass. Go get them.

badges.name: Cold Mains
badges.desc: When the pipes shook, you found the holes in the walls. Somebody dug them for a reason.

badges.name: Flash Bang
badges.desc: He can’t stand the light. Strike one in his face and watch him run.

badges.name: Grandma’s Favorite
badges.desc: She just wants a hug. Most people crawl away. Don’t.

badges.name: Blackout
badges.desc: The night janitor is blind. He hears everything. You learned to be still when the bucket squeaks.

badges.name: Soft Ground
badges.desc: The floor breathed under you and you kept moving. The ones who sat still are still down there.

badges.name: The Lantern Man
badges.desc: He only takes people in the dark. The moths want the dark. You had to choose, every time.

badges.name: Toll Roads
badges.desc: Three caps a junction. You never shorted him. Never crawled into him. Not even backwards.

badges.name: Head Office
badges.desc: Management would like a word about your performance. You never stopped moving. Custom Night is yours.

badges.name: Clean Air
badges.desc: The vents are clean. Too clean. It crawls on its hands and it smiles the whole way. Out of sight is out of mind.

badges.name: Seen Them All
badges.desc: Everything down here has a rule. You learned ten of them the hard way.

badges.name: Scheduled Maintenance
badges.desc: It cleans the same route every night. Every night. Learn it. Don’t be on it.

badges.name: Pest Control
badges.desc: When the rats run, run with them. The yellow air is slower than you. Don’t wait to find out how slow.

badges.name: High Risk, No Reward
badges.desc: Survive Rampage without hiding or using an item.

badges.name: You’ve Been Served
badges.desc: She smiles when she hands it to you. Take it. Be where it says. And if you can’t... get home.

badges.name: No Safe Place
badges.desc: Clear night 9 or 10 without going back into the safe room after you’ve left it.

badges.name: Final Inspection
badges.desc: It got bigger. It got faster. It’s still smiling. Nothing in the vents has ever been this hungry.

badges.name: Untouched
badges.desc:
Head Office. The whole crew walked out. Nobody has ever done that.

Beat Ch1 Night 10 with nobody in the crew dying

badges.name: Bare Hands
badges.desc: Clear night 10 without using a single item.

badges.name: Contempt of Court
badges.desc: You said no. She stopped smiling. The safe room is the only place she can’t follow.

badges.name: Exact Change
badges.desc: Three caps. Three times. Tom says never short him.

badges.name: Lone Shift
badges.desc:
No crew. No radio voices but his. Just you and Head Office.

Beat Ch1 Night 10 solo

badges.name: Fresh Cuts
badges.desc: Clear Chapter 2, Night 6. Something waits at the end of the long ducts, breathing. When it screams, get off the line. You can’t outrun it.

badges.name: Overtime
badges.desc: Ten nights. Hard mode. Every single one. PIPE CO. thanks you for your service.

badges.name: Old Staff
badges.desc: Clear Chapter 2, Night 7. They never clocked out. If something leans out of a hiding hole and stares at you, that hole’s taken.

badges.name: Probation
badges.desc: Clear Chapter 2, Night 8. The new guy keeps undoing your work, and the ducts are wired. Wait for the zap, then go.

badges.name: Water Damage
badges.desc: Clear Chapter 2, Night 9. It came down with the rain. Never stop under it, and don’t splash.

badges.name: Mother
badges.desc: Clear Chapter 2, Night 10. Burn every growth. Stay cold. She’s dead, and the vents are finally quiet.

badges.name: A Cup of Coffee
badges.desc: Clear night 10 on HARD without your heat ever dropping below half (I picked 50%; the suggestion said 50–75%).

badges.name: Shock Therapy
badges.desc: Lead a monster that’s chasing you into a zap gate as it fires.

badges.name: That's Fire Bro
badges.desc: Burn 3 of the growths yourself in one night. (Ch.2 Night 10)

badges.name: Sixth Sense
badges.desc: Beat Chapter 1 Night 6, 7 or 8 without ever opening your map.

badges.name: Dry Run
badges.desc: Beat Chapter 2 Night 9 without splashing a single puddle.

badges.name: Not On The Menu
badges.desc: Get charged by the Flesh 3 times in one night and never get hit.

badges.name: Versatile
badges.desc: In one night: scare the Janitor with a wrench, lure the Moths with a glow stick, and scare Randal with a flare.

badges.name: Reverse Gear
badges.desc: Clear night 6, 7 or 8 crawling backward more than forward (at least 10 backward crawls).

THIS GAME WILL NOT BE CRAZILY p2w no matter what

A silent outbreak has hit Manhattan. Can you contain it before the city falls?

Last Stand is a top-down zombie outbreak strategy game. Thousands of New Yorkers go about their day while the infected hide among them, until they turn.

Build quarantine walls and checkpoint gates, send recon drones to expose hidden carriers, and deploy medics to cure the infected. Evacuate survivors by ferry and helicopter, fortify streets with machine-gun nests, and call in strike teams or a full bombing run when the horde gets too big.

Watch out for Runners, Brutes, Screamers and Bloaters, and for the night, when zombies get faster.

5 difficulties, from Easy to Nightmare
A full map of Manhattan, from the Battery to Inwood
Earn Research Points every game for permanent upgrades
Unlock a second HQ strike team

Save the city or watch it fall.

10770728771.creator: Roblox Presents
10770728771.description:
There is no official record of ‘The Hollow.’
How long it has existed is unknown.
Its exact location is unclear.

We are asking you not to go in.

If you decide to go in anyway, please be advised: 

We cannot say where you will end up each night. 
You may think you know where you are.
You may recognize what is waiting for you. 
None of it should be there.

Some creators are going in live. 
We could not stop them.
They may need your help.

Other games may be connected to The Hollow. 
What you find there can help you inside.

If you are still there on October 31, you will not be the only one trying to get out. 
And not everyone will.

We cannot keep it closed. 
It opens October 22 2pm PT. It starts 3pm PT.

Anything you find is yours to keep.
Complete event quests, here and in participating experiences, to earn avatar items.

10762148295.creator: • DELTA •
10762148295.description:
🐺 You found a stray wolf at the edge of the woods. You named him Jerry.
Every morning, he leaves something dead beside your bed. 🦴

Someone uploaded a strange build of the game, then deleted it a day later. You installed it anyway. The world was already there... and so was Bob.

🌲 FEATURES
🐾 Tame Jerry with bones and keep him close
🛏️ Build a camp and survive until morning
🗺️ Follow Bob's map to his cabin, his grave and his log
🔦 Explore a huge blocky world of caves, forests and marshes
👥 Play solo or with up to 8 players
💀 10 endings to uncover
⛏️ Survival Mode: the same world, no story
🎨 Capes for you, collars for Jerry

Can you figure out what's wrong with Jerry before it's too late?

🎮 CONTROLS
WASD - Move | E - Inventory | M - Map
Left Click - Break / Attack | Right Click - Place / Use

👍 Like and favourite for updates!
⚠️ Contains jumpscares and blood. Play with the lights on.

Inspired by LookOut2DD's "Something Is Wrong With My Dog..."
